correctness.rationale: Every real projection averages under prism signed-edge automorphisms without increasing its ℓ1 norm. Every invariant projection has the complete t/s_i parameterization, coefficient equation 2a_i+b_{i-1}-b_i=1_{i=0}, and column norm pair H,V. Cyclic total variation and signed two-sided five-pair bounds give 4H+V≥12−16/n for every n≥10, including all boundary cases. The explicit four-support b sequence produces a genuine circulation projection with H=V=12/5−16/(5n). The packaged verify.py checks exact divergence, cycle identity and column norms on n=10,…,30; the proof alone quantifies over all integers n≥10.

value.rationale: The natural cycle space of every 3-regular n-gonal prism for n≥10 has an exact nonconstant relative ℓ1 projection invariant, λ=12/5−16/(5n), tending sharply to 12/5. The formula has an explicit finite-support minimizer and a local five-site universal dual inequality, providing a reusable benchmark for metric transportation and graph-cycle complementation beyond previously treated graph products; it is not a single small computation or arbitrary slice.
